label: Akkar & Bommer (2010)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Akkar & Bommer (2010)

site.anchor_note: b7_soft_soil / b8_stiff_soil confirm rock as the reference class.

mechanism.anchor_note: b9_normal / b10_reverse confirm strike-slip as the reference class.

parameters.equation: log y = b1 + b2*M + b3*M^2 + (b4 + b5*M)*log(sqrt(Rjb^2 + b6^2)) + site terms + mechanism terms

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for b1-b10. PGA coefficients and both sigma components are now available.

implementation_notes: The published form is written 'log y' without naming the base. RESOLVE before coding - this is exactly the silent error rule 1 warns about.
Magnitude-dependent distance attenuation through the (b4 + b5*M) term.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Later European model with compact form.
parameters.log_base_note: Resolved: the appendix states log_base 10, settling the ambiguity in the 'log y' form.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 0 km (rjb)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 99 km (rjb)
resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/akkar_bommer_2010.py declares IMC.GEOMETRIC_MEAN (p. 196)
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/akkar_bommer_2010.py coefficient table; period count and range (60 periods, 0.05-3 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked. The OpenQuake table also carries 0.01-0.04 s and 4.0 s rows (4.0 s is scaled by 1/0.8 in code); those are implementation extensions outside the published 0.05-3 s range and are excluded.
